name: Rike + Márcio Reis
description: Rike and Márcio Reis perform a live concert followed by a DJ set at Era uma vez em Paris in Porto.
longDescription:
Rike and Márcio Reis bring a live concert and DJ set to Era uma vez em Paris on 28 November 2026. The night starts with the concert at 22:00, followed by the DJ set at 00:30.

The venue is located at Rua da Galeria de Paris, 106, in Porto. The event is strictly for attendees aged 18 and over.
